reason: Both plans satisfy every hard requirement, but Response B is slightly more rigorous in its sequencing: it explicitly reuses the pre-migration backup to validate restorability during the rehearsal, adds a dedicated step to incorporate rehearsal findings and get engineering sign-off before proceeding, and gives concrete communication timing (one week ahead plus a 24-hour reminder) rather than a generic notification.
